Old-timers swear he eats Mire Prowlers for breakfast, and even the Mirefen Widows won't spin their webs near the Deepfen Shallows out of sheer terror. He rules those waters, and marsh water takes an Ironreel Fishing Rod, no less; my counter sells them. Get one in hand, drag that old devil out of his waters, and I will admit you have joined the family.
quests.completion: By the damp saints... The Codfather himself. Look at those whiskers. Fenbridge will eat stories off this catch for a year, {playerName}.

quests.title: The Treant Accord
quests.text: The elders of the Grove shed their outer bark as the corruption gnaws at their roots. Four lengths of it, and I can brew a salve for the whole Grove. They will not thank you while you pry it loose, {playerName}, but they will stand a century longer for it.
quests.completion: Thick and sound, all four. The salve will take a week to brew and a hundred years to finish its work. Trees measure kindness differently.

quests.title: Fetish and Bone
quests.text: I crawled the troll mounds two nights past. Those fetishes they plant are not troll-craft: the knots are wrong, the bones are man-bones, and every one points at the open barrows like a signpost. Bring me 8 of them and I will prove to Fenwick who is really paying for this dig.
quests.completion: Same maker as the banners in the cult camp. The trolls are hired shovels, nothing more. Good work, {playerName}.

quests.title: Mounds of the Mirefen
quests.text: The Mirefen trolls have torn open the old barrow-mounds east of the far lake: burial mounds, {playerName}, older than any kingdom of men. Whatever gold they think is down there, what they are letting OUT is worse. Drive them off the mounds: 12 trolls dead ought to do it.
quests.completion: Trolls don't dig without a reason. Someone told them where to dig, and I'd wager my gate it wears a grey robe.

quests.title: The Thinned Veil
quests.text: So the cave opened for you. Then the seal is weaker than I feared, {playerName}. Where the veil tears, the wisps turn dark and cold. Bring me eight essences from the duskwisps and I will read how deep the wound runs.
quests.completion: Cold, every one of them. The Hollow has perhaps a season before the tear becomes a rift. We have work to do, you and I.

quests.title: The Grand Necromancer
quests.text: Every thread we have followed (Morthen, Vael, the phylacteries) was spun by one hand: Grand Necromancer Velkhar, first of the Gravecallers, keeper of the waking rite. He stands in the ritual vault below, pouring two lands' worth of stolen souls into the Wyrm. End him, {playerName}, and the tithe ends with him.
quests.completion: Velkhar is dead, and the rite is headless. But you felt it down there, did you not? The souls are already spent: the Wyrm is no longer asleep.

quests.title: The Voice Below
quests.text: Last night the whole cult camp knelt at once, {playerName}, every zealot and necromancer facing the Sanctum, and one throat led the chant. They call him Threnos, the First Voice, and Korzul speaks through his mouth. Vael heard the same voice in the fen, and Morthen before him. Silence Threnos and cut down the six necromancers who keep his choir, before that voice has hands enough to pull the gate open itself.
quests.completion: Threnos is silent, and the kneeling has stopped, {playerName}. We have not ended the voice below, only taken from it the mouth that carried it. It must be enough.

quests.title: The Waking Warden
quests.text: The court is quiet, but its master is not. The Warden that holds the seal has woken twisted, and while it stands, the seal cannot be mended. It will not fall easily; bring a friend if you can find one, {playerName}. Bring two if you can find two.
quests.completion: The bell of its voice is silent. I felt it from here, like a weight lifted off the whole valley.

quests.title: Echoes of the Warden
quests.text: Even with their master silenced, the court guardians repeat its last command like an echo that will not fade. Until the seal is set back, they will keep waking, {playerName}. Still ten more of them so the masons can reach the sealstone.
quests.completion: The echo grows fainter each time. Soon the court will hold nothing but wind and ivy, the way a ruin should.

quests.title: Across the Fenway
quests.text: A gentle country, the Willowfen, but gentle is not the same as safe, {playerName}. Follow the road north to the Fenway causeway and cross into Bridgemere. Tell Bridgewright Alden the Steps are open and the waycamp fire is lit.
quests.completion: Pell keeps that fire burning through every fog the fen can breathe at her. If she says the Steps are open, they are open. Welcome to Bridgemere, {playerName}. Watch your step on my planks and we will get along fine.

quests.title: The Croaker's Hush
quests.text: Now you know the snorer's name, {playerName}: the Drowsy Croaker, the old toad-king out on the Drowsy Flats. Every year his croak grows heavier, and every year more of the fen forgets to wake. The charms will keep your eyes open, but his bulk is another matter: bring a friend, and do not fight him in the water. Put the old king to a quieter sleep.
quests.completion: Listen, {playerName}. Nothing. The first true silence over this fen in thirty years, and half the town will not sleep tonight for the strangeness of it. The willows say thank you, in their way. Wear this, woven from his own lily-bed, and the fen will know you for a friend wherever the water reaches.

quests.title: Eels for the Smokehouse
quests.text: The bogtoads are not just eating my ropes, {playerName}, they are eating my catch: they gulp the eels down whole, straight out of the traps. Cut six plump ones free of the greedy things before the meat spoils, and the smokehouse fires stay lit.
quests.completion: Six good eels, barely bruised. The smokehouse will smell like money by morning. Here, these waders were mine when I was quicker: eelskin turns the wet like nothing else.

quests.title: Mind the Moorings
quests.text: Good rope is dear out here, {playerName}: every line the toads bite through is a week of eel-money gone. The cut ends are still lying along the moat shore where the boats slipped them. Walk the boardwalks and bring me back four lines, and I can splice them good as new.
quests.completion: Look at that: clean bites, every one, but there is rope enough left to splice. You have saved me a month of coin and the netters a month of grumbling, {playerName}.

quests.title: The Rope-Chewers
quests.text: Bogtoads, {playerName}. They haul up out of the moat at night and chew through my mooring ropes like they were reed stems. Three skiffs went drifting last week, and one of them had my good winch aboard. Thin them out, ten of the fat things, and the boats stay where we tie them.
quests.completion: Ten fewer sets of teeth in my moat. The skiffs sat their moorings all night for the first time in a month, {playerName}. You have the thanks of every netter in town.

quests.title: Toll and Tangle
quests.text: The willow sprites think it is a fine game to cut a ferry loose, {playerName}, and last week the toll skiff went over on the east track with a season of bridge-toll aboard. The chests went down in the shallows and the sprites dance on the boardwalks like they own them. Drive off eight and haul up three toll-chests, and Bridgemere eats this winter.
quests.completion: Three chests, and the coin still dry inside. The sprites will sulk in the withies for a week, {playerName}, and the town owes you its winter bread.

quests.title: Wisplight Charms
quests.text: The wisps over the pools are the fen dreaming out loud, {playerName}, and their light is the only thing that holds against the Croaker's lull. I weave it into willow charms: one round your neck and the snore cannot drag your eyelids down. Bring me six wisplight globes. The wisps will not fight you for them, which makes it a kindness or a theft, depending on how you carry it.
quests.completion: Six globes, still warm with dreaming. Give me till moonrise and I will have charms woven for you and whoever is brave enough to stand beside you.

quests.title: The Witch of Willowweep
quests.text: You have heard it by now, {playerName}: the snore. Slow and heavy, out past the Drowsy Flats, like the fen itself turning over in its sleep. The toads, the sprites, the wisps burning at noon: it all started when that sound did. One soul might know what it is. Mother Sedge keeps a camp at Willowweep, west around the moat and down the far shore. Find her, and ask her what sleeps at the middle of my fen.
quests.completion: Alden sent you all this way to ask about the snoring? Then the bridge-folk are finally listening. Sit down out of the damp, {playerName}. That sound has a name, and a throat, and I have been waiting for someone fool enough to help me quiet it.

quests.title: Silk and Venom
quests.text: The fog-sick are coming in from the drowned hamlets faster than I can bed them: fevered, and forgetting their own names. Widow venom, drawn fine, is the only thing that keeps their heads clear. But the thicket west of the road has gone from nuisance to horror; the webs are taking deer whole now. Kill 10 widows and cut me 6 venom sacs, whole and unburst.
quests.completion: Whole sacs, every one. A woman asked me this morning who her husband was. Tonight she will remember. You have steadier hands than half the surgeons in the south, {playerName}.

quests.title: Lights of the Shallows
quests.text: The glimmerwisps carry motes of the old starlight that fell here when the Hollow was sealed. Six motes, and the shrine lamps will burn for a year. Take only from those that fade; the Hollow gives enough without greed.
quests.completion: Soft as the first stars. Set them here by the altar; the shrine will do the rest.

quests.title: Wolves at the Door
quests.text: The forest wolves grow bold, snapping at travelers on the north road. Thin their numbers, {playerName}. Slay 8 Forest Wolves and Eastbrook will breathe easier.
quests.completion: Fine work. The road feels safer already.

quests.title: The Bells of Gibbetmere
quests.text: Hear that tolling, {playerName}? That is Gibbetmere, up the north road, ringing its dead to sleep. Sexton Marrow keeps the count of every soul under the canopy, living and buried. Go and be counted, before the wood counts you itself.
quests.completion: Cobb sent you up the road whole, did he? Good man. He has kept those gate lanterns lit for thirty years, and the wood has never once got past him. Welcome to Gibbetmere, {playerName}. Mind the bells.

quests.title: Candles at the Bounds
quests.text: Four boundary stones ring Gibbetmere, {playerName}, one on each road out, and a grave-candle burns on every stone. While they burn, the buried stay buried. The drizzle has drowned them, all four, and I am too old to walk the bounds alone. Take my taper and relight them, quickly.
quests.completion: All four burning? Then breathe, {playerName}. You did not hear it, but the whole village did: the bells rang easier the moment the last wick caught.

quests.title: The Horn of the Huntsman
quests.text: You have heard the horn by now, {playerName}, thin and far off, the sound the whole wood holds its breath for. The Pale Huntsman rides his clearing north of here, and every grave he passes grows shallower. He was a man once, and he was buried wrong, and I am done pretending prayer will do it. Take a friend, take two, and unhorse him.
quests.completion: The horn stopped mid-note. Every bell in Gibbetmere rang once, on its own, and then the wood went quieter than I have heard it in thirty years. You have done the rite I could not, {playerName}. Wear this, and walk under the canopy unafraid.

quests.title: Silk in the Eaves
quests.text: Look up when you walk the west road, {playerName}, and you will see them: wrapped shapes in the canopy, swaying where no wind reaches. The widowsilk spinners have crept out of the Thicket and strung their larders over my lanterns. Kill ten, and the road is a road again.
quests.completion: Ten fewer weavers in the eaves. The lamplighters will walk their rounds tonight without looking up, and that is worth more here than you know.

quests.title: The Last Vicar
quests.text: South of here the Mournstone Chapel moulders by its black tarn, and one man still tends it: Vicar Creel, who would not leave when the roof came down. He knows the old rites better than my bells do, {playerName}, and he has not sent word in a month. Walk the chapel road and see him breathing.
quests.completion: Marrow worries after me? That is new. Tell him the Mournstone stands, after a fashion, and so do I. Stay a while, {playerName}. The tarn has been whispering, and I would rather not listen alone.

quests.title: Walking Mosley Home
quests.text: My gravedigger Mosley took the chapel road three days ago to open a plot in the old yard, and the dig came down on top of him. He clawed his way out, the fool is alive, but he is huddled by the chapel graves and will not move for spinners on the road. Walk him home, {playerName}. I cannot ring the bells for a living man.
quests.completion: He came through the gate on his own two feet, swearing he will dig nothing deeper than a turnip bed from now on. He will be back at the yard by Sunday, they always are. Thank you, {playerName}. Gibbetmere keeps its people, that is the whole of our law.

objectives.label: Gravedigger Mosley walked safely back to Gibbetmere

quests.title: What the Bark Holds
quests.text: In the Hanging Glade east of Gibbetmere the spinners hang their silk-wrapped dead from the boughs, and the gravenbark shamblers stand guard beneath like patient pallbearers. Those are our people up there, {playerName}. Break five shamblers, cut down three of the wrapped dead, and bring them home to soil.
quests.completion: Three souls back under honest ground before nightfall. The shamblers will grow back, bark always does, but tonight the glade hangs empty, and that is enough.

quests.title: The Widow's Skeins
quests.text: The spinners take our dead for their larders, {playerName}, so I take their silk for our shrouds. It burns clean and it holds a blessing better than linen ever did. Bring me six skeins of widowsilk, and the next soul we bury goes down wrapped and warded.
quests.completion: Six skeins, soft as a held breath. The dead will lie easier in this. Take these wraps, I sewed them from the last batch, and the wood has never once bitten through them.

quests.title: Wraiths of the Tarn
quests.text: The wood wraiths were the chapel wardens once, {playerName}, grown from trees planted over the honored dead. Since the tarn turned black they have forgotten their office, and now they drift through my graveyard pulling at the soil. Break eight of them apart before they finish what they have started.
quests.completion: Eight wardens laid down at last. I will not call it a mercy in daylight, but between us, {playerName}, it was one.

quests.title: Sigils of the Wyrm
quests.text: It is time you knew the whole of it, {playerName}. The Gravecallers serve Korzul the Gravewyrm (an ancient dragon sealed beneath this mountain), and every soul they have stolen since Eastbrook is a tithe poured into its waking. On the Sanctum Approach the cult has laid sigils to thin the seal. Bring me three; I would read the rite they are working.
quests.completion: Yes... a waking-litany, generations in the writing. They are close, {playerName}. Closer than I dared fear.

quests.title: Chants on the Wind
quests.text: When the wind comes off the southern peaks, {playerName}, it carries chanting. The Broodsworn no longer hides: they have raised tents below the Sanctum and they sing to what sleeps beneath it. Silence twelve zealots. Every voice stilled buys the mountain another night of sleep.
quests.completion: The wind is quieter. But what troubles me is not the chanting, {playerName}. It is that something may be chanting back.

npcs.name: Alchemist Verane
npcs.title: Master of the Apothecary
npcs.greeting: Measure twice and pour once, {className}. The apothecary has no patience for spilled reagents.

npcs.name: Ivara Fenmoss
npcs.title: Herbalist
npcs.greeting: Careful where you step in the northeastern woods, friend.

npcs.name: Ivara Fenmoss
npcs.title: Herbalist
npcs.greeting: The stones are listening. Be polite.

npcs.name: Maelin's Ember Projection
npcs.title: Ember Projection
npcs.greeting: The embers carry Maelin's voice forward through the forge.

npcs.name: Archivist Maelin Emberward
npcs.title: Crucible Archivist
npcs.greeting: Every hammer mark in this place is a sentence. Help me read what Varkhul tried to hide.

npcs.name: Archivist Tullo
npcs.title: Reader of Stones
npcs.greeting: The monuments out there have not spoken to anyone in an age. Perhaps they were waiting for fresh ears.

npcs.name: Armorer Hode
npcs.title: Master Armorer
npcs.greeting: Forge is hot and the grindstone is turning. If it cuts, I sell it.

npcs.name: Merrin Coyle
npcs.title: Assayer
npcs.greeting: Every stone tells you what it is, if you ask it the right way. Most people only ask with a hammer.

npcs.name: Astronomer Cassian
npcs.title: Watcher at the Vigil
npcs.greeting: Hush now. The sky never dawns here, so it never stops talking either.

npcs.name: Auctioneer Voss
npcs.title: Keeper of the World Market
npcs.greeting: The World Market is open here too, {className}. Buy from every adventurer in the realm, or set out your own wares.

npcs.name: Aurorist Veyla
npcs.title: Reader of the Lights
npcs.greeting: Hush. The lights are speaking tonight, and they do not repeat themselves.

npcs.name: Bellkeeper Tam
npcs.title: Watchbell Keeper
npcs.greeting: The bell is the only warning the breaks give us, {className}. One toll for the fields, two for the cliffs, three when it is close enough that running will not help. Keep an ear on it, and it may keep you whole.

npcs.name: Bridgewright Alden
npcs.title: Master of the Fenway
npcs.greeting: Every plank in this town is mine to keep, and the fen chews on all of them.

npcs.name: Brother Aldric
npcs.title: Priest of the Vale
npcs.greeting: The Light keep you. Even the dead find no rest here of late.

npcs.name: Brother Aldric
npcs.title: Priest of the Vale
npcs.greeting: The Light keep you above the water, {playerName}. The dead in this fen do not sleep: they wade.

npcs.name: Brother Aldric
npcs.title: Priest of the Vale
npcs.greeting: From a chapel yard in the Vale to the roof of the world... the trail we have followed ends here. I can feel the mountain listening.

npcs.name: Brother Aldric
npcs.title: Priest of the Vale
npcs.greeting: From a chapel yard in the Vale to the roof of the world... the trail we have followed ends here. I can feel the mountain listening.

npcs.name: Brother Halven
npcs.title: Reliquary Keeper
npcs.greeting: The reliquary below has shifted again.

npcs.name: Brother Halven
npcs.title: Reliquary Keeper
npcs.greeting: The trail led north. Another reliquary, another rite. Choose your tier, and I'll hold the rope until you return.

npcs.name: Bursar Aldous Crane
npcs.title: The Gilded Strongbox
npcs.greeting: Every crate, coffer, and trinket is safe with the Gilded Strongbox.

npcs.name: Bursar Fernando
npcs.title: The Gilded Strongbox
npcs.greeting: Welcome to the Gilded Strongbox. Your goods rest safe behind our locks.

npcs.name: Bursar Petra Vell
npcs.title: The Gilded Strongbox
npcs.greeting: The Gilded Strongbox keeps clean ledgers and cleaner vaults. What shall we stow for you?

npcs.name: Bursar Wick
npcs.title: The Gilded Strongbox
npcs.greeting: The Gilded Strongbox keeps a desk even here, {playerName}. Whatever you deposit with me waits in the same vault behind every bursar in every town, safe from wolves, water, and your own worse judgment.

npcs.name: Apprentice Tessa
npcs.title: Student of Calligraphy
npcs.greeting: I keep turning too soon. Will you show me where the corners belong?

npcs.name: Apprentice Pip
npcs.title: Student of Calligraphy
npcs.greeting: A triangle first, then a square, then a rune. One steady step at a time!

npcs.name: Instructor Elian
npcs.title: Arcane Calligraphy
npcs.greeting: A steady step makes a steady line. Teach my apprentices a triangle, a square, and an advanced rune.

npcs.name: Laverock
npcs.title: Last Cantor of the Pale Choir
npcs.greeting: I was the youngest voice of the Pale Choir. On the night of the rite I did not drink, and I ran. Every full moon since, I hear them singing under the water. I must see her before I die. Let me walk behind you. I will not fight, and I will not slow you.

npcs.name: Captain Thessaly
npcs.title: Highwatch Captain
npcs.greeting: Two hundred years this wall has held, {className}. It will not break on my watch, but it groans.

npcs.name: Card Master
npcs.title: Dealer of Chance
npcs.greeting: Care for a Card Duel? Best of three, winner takes the bragging rights.

npcs.name: Bryony Cooperwick
npcs.title: Carpenter
npcs.greeting: Chalk is only stone that has not made up its mind. I can work with that.

npcs.name: Bryony Cooperwick
npcs.title: Carpenter
npcs.greeting: I came to look at one press. They have shown me four, and a cart, and a fence with feelings.

npcs.name: Wenna Nookwright
npcs.title: Carpenter
npcs.greeting: Measure twice, panic once. Then measure again, just to be safe.

npcs.name: Gyles Charwood
npcs.title: Charcoal Burner
npcs.greeting: Soot washes off. Wolves do not. I will take the soot.

npcs.name: Chronicler Zenzie
npcs.title: The Peaks Chronicle
npcs.greeting: The mountain forgets nothing, {playerName}, and neither do I. Let us see what you have done.

npcs.name: Chronicler Osric Fenn
npcs.title: The Marsh Chronicle
npcs.greeting: Mind the damp on the pages, {playerName}. The fen eats more books than readers ever will.

npcs.name: Saul the Chronicler
npcs.title: The Vale Chronicle
npcs.greeting: Every deed worth doing is worth writing down twice, {playerName}: once for the ledger and once for the fireside.

npcs.name: Mabel Cotterill
npcs.title: Pressford Cider-Master
npcs.greeting: Pressford makes the best cider in the Reaches, and the second best, and most of the third.

npcs.name: Ambrose Pennick
npcs.title: Coinwell Claim-Master
npcs.greeting: Every stone on this coast belongs to somebody. My job is knowing who, and my headache is everyone else knowing better.

npcs.name: Tobias Wren
npcs.title: Contract Clerk
npcs.greeting: Three contracts a week, posted every reset. No signing, no fees: see one through and the seals are yours.

npcs.name: Cook Marlow
npcs.title: Master of the Kitchens
npcs.greeting: Nothing leaves my kitchens half-cooked, {className}. Sit, eat, then get back out there.

npcs.name: Nettie Saltmarsh
npcs.title: Coinwell Camp Cook
npcs.greeting: Stew is ready when it is ready, and it is never ready when the gulls are watching.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Bronn Emberward
npcs.title: Crucible Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: The forge marks its own. Bring me a sigil from the Crucible and I will fit you for war.

npcs.name: Drillmaster Hale
npcs.title: Quay Sparring Master
npcs.greeting: That dummy behind me never swings back and never goes down, {className}. What matters is the tally: your Damage Meters count every blow you land on it. Target it and open the meters, and I will walk you through the rest.

npcs.name: Drillmaster Rook
npcs.title: Yard Master
npcs.greeting: Straw first, shells second, {playerName}. An effigy teaches your arm the swing; the scuttlers down the strand teach it to land on something that minds.

npcs.name: Vault Keeper
npcs.title: Weekly Rewards
npcs.greeting: Your weekly rewards await. Choose one item from your earned choices after the Crucible reset.

npcs.name: Farmer Hollis
npcs.title: Highwatch Terrace Farmer
npcs.greeting: The terraces give what the mountain allows, {className}. I sell seed and compost, and if a crop of yours comes up withered I will work the husks back into good soil for you.

npcs.name: Farmer Jessica
npcs.title: Allotment Keeper
npcs.greeting: Good soil and fair weather, {playerName}. Buy a seed from me, sow it in one of those beds, and go about your day. It keeps growing while you are away, and it never spoils. Your Harvest Journal (Shift+K, or the Farming row of your Professions window) lists every planted bed and its timer.

npcs.name: Farmer Teasel
npcs.title: Fen Paddy Farmer
npcs.greeting: Marsh rice and bog beet seed, {className}, and compost to feed them. The paddies drain slow, so mind where you tread.

npcs.name: Farmer Verbena
npcs.title: Parterre Gardener
npcs.greeting: Mind the edging, {playerName}, these beds are the pride of the parterre. Seed and compost are what I sell, and I will turn any withered husks you carry into more of it.

npcs.name: Captain Fenlow Tippet
npcs.title: Ferry Captain
npcs.greeting: Fresh off the crossing, {playerName}? Warden Tam keeps the Gauntlet on the strand just south of my pier: run his lanes first and your legs will thank you. Every keeper on this shore hands you to the next when your work is done, and the card at the top of your screen always knows the way. When the vale calls you back, ring the bell standing beside my pier and the crossing will set you down in Eastbrook town.

npcs.name: Captain Fenlow Tippet
npcs.title: Ferry Captain
npcs.greeting: I came round the coast by boat. The sea kept changing its mind about where the shore was.

npcs.name: Ferrymaster Caddow
npcs.title: Keeper of the Lantern Ferries
npcs.greeting: Fog is on the Mere again. When the lanterns go out on the water, wise folk stay ashore.

npcs.name: Frightened Nell
npcs.title: Gullhaven Fisher
npcs.greeting: It opened right where the nets dry. Right there, where I stood every morning of my life. I do not go down to the shore anymore. I do not go much of anywhere anymore.

npcs.name: Fisherman Brandt
npcs.title: Old Salt
npcs.greeting: Blrb-glub... sorry, been listening to those fish-men too long.

npcs.name: Tobbin Wickerby
npcs.title: Fisherman
npcs.greeting: Never trust a fish with good manners. The polite ones are planning something.

npcs.name: Foreman Odell
npcs.title: Mine Foreman
npcs.greeting: Whole dig's crawling with those dirt-caked vermin!

npcs.name: Smith Mara
npcs.title: Wyrmwatch Smith
npcs.greeting: Help me finish a shield! Click the supplies I call for. Quick hands earn a better medal.

npcs.name: Brunna Flintmorrow
npcs.title: Master of the Forge
npcs.greeting: The forge answers to me, {className}. Bring good ore and it will answer to you too.

npcs.name: Brunna Flintmorrow
npcs.title: Master of the Forge
npcs.greeting: Metal tells the truth. People rarely bother. This ore is telling me something, and I do not like its tone.

npcs.name: FURY
npcs.title: Honor Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: The sands remember every victory. Spend your honor well.

npcs.name: Della Brindlepot
npcs.title: Gardener
npcs.greeting: If it grows, I have argued with it. If it grows well, I won.

npcs.name: Hester Applegarth
npcs.title: Gardener
npcs.greeting: Pressford grows apples the way Eastbrook grows opinions: everywhere, and mostly on purpose.

npcs.name: Gardener Yew
npcs.title: The Last Gardener
npcs.greeting: Hand me that barrow, would you? These lawns do not walk themselves, whatever the hamlet thinks.

npcs.name: Gatecaptain Brannoc
npcs.title: Commander of Wyrmwatch
npcs.greeting: Wyrmwatch holds the gate. Has held it forty years. It will hold it tonight.

npcs.name: Gatewarden Pell
npcs.title: Keeper of the Garden Gate
npcs.greeting: Mind how you go on the lawns. The garden keeps them trimmed, and it likes them tidy.

npcs.name: Skye
npcs.title: Zephyrs Apprentice
npcs.greeting: Great flight down the canyon. Speak with me whenever you need a magical updraft back to Zephyr at The Shear.

npcs.name: Flightmaster Zephyr
npcs.title: Windrider Instructor
npcs.greeting: The thermals howling off the cliffs of The Shear are fierce today. Ready to strap into the mechanical glider and test your wings through the slalom course?

npcs.name: Hester Gourdwick
npcs.title: Gourdlight Keeper
npcs.greeting: The gourds are lit and the lanterns are up, so it must be Gourdlight Eve. I have an errand for you every day of it, in Eastbrook, Fenbridge and Highwatch. Do it and I will pay you in sweets. Bring the sweets to me, at any of my stalls, and I will trade you something to wear.

npcs.name: Bertram Ashcombe
npcs.title: Gravekeeper
npcs.greeting: Mind the paths between the stones. The ones beneath them have earned their quiet.

npcs.name: Garrick Holt
npcs.title: Guild Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: Seals for honors, friend. Nothing on my shelves will sharpen a blade, but every hall in Highwatch will know where you earned it.

npcs.name: Mira Fairweather
npcs.title: Guild Recruiter
npcs.greeting: Looking for a party? Every crypt, bastion and temple on this map has a name on my list. Tell me where you are headed.

npcs.name: Hesper Dunmore
npcs.title: Guildmaster of Lantern Hall
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Lantern Hall, {className}. Tobias keeps the week's contracts on the board, Garrick trades our seals for honors worth wearing, and Mira will find you a party for any door below the mountain. Bring back a trophy and it hangs in the hall behind me.

npcs.name: Harbormaster Odile
npcs.title: Harbormaster of Wickharbor
npcs.greeting: Every boat in this cove owes the Old Beacon its keel. Speak quick, the tide will not wait.

npcs.name: Harbormaster Tamsin
npcs.title: Keeper of the Wyrmwatch Quays
npcs.greeting: Come in off the quay and warm your hands. The ship at our pier sails up the long east coast to Wickharbor and back again. Far to the west, the other ferry runs between Eastbrook and the Nightbloom. The map on the wall shows both crossings. Rest by the fire before the climb to Wyrmwatch.

npcs.name: Head Gardener Amaranth
npcs.title: Head Gardener of the Evergarden
npcs.greeting: Do not mind the shadows under my eyes. Someone has to stay awake while the garden dreams.

npcs.name: Hearthkeeper Maeve
npcs.title: Keeper of the Hearth-Lodge
npcs.greeting: Come in off the cold. The lodge fire never goes out, so long as I draw breath.

npcs.name: Olvessa
npcs.title: Herb Terrace Keeper
npcs.greeting: Mud remembers every footprint, and so do the herbs. Tread kindly here.

npcs.name: Herbalist Yara
npcs.title: Bracken Circle Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: Mind the thicket west of the road. The webs are thick as sailcloth this season.

npcs.name: Okrim
npcs.title: The Man Who Went In
npcs.greeting: Quiet now. The drums count everything that walks under the trees, and they have already counted you.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Vex
npcs.title: Heroic Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: Proof of the heroic depths buys the finest rings and pendants in Highwatch. Show me your marks.

npcs.name: Orwin Pellock
npcs.title: Historian
npcs.greeting: That is either impossible or extremely inconvenient. Possibly both. Have I eaten today?

npcs.name: Huntsman Deral
npcs.title: Warden of the Herds
npcs.greeting: Quiet now. The herd knows every sound this valley makes, and so do I.

npcs.name: Guard Bram
npcs.title: Fenbridge Watch
npcs.greeting: Reporting for duty.

npcs.name: Sergeant Alric
npcs.title: Fenbridge Watch
npcs.greeting: A creature has stolen a soldier's face. Read the standing orders and the watch ledger, question all four guards, then come back and name the one whose story contradicts our records.

npcs.name: Guard Nella
npcs.title: Fenbridge Watch
npcs.greeting: Reporting for duty.

npcs.name: Guard Orin
npcs.title: Fenbridge Watch
npcs.greeting: Reporting for duty.

npcs.name: Guard Tessa
npcs.title: Fenbridge Watch
npcs.greeting: Reporting for duty.

npcs.name: Jorren
npcs.title: Innkeeper
npcs.greeting: It could be worse. Usually is. Sit, eat, and tell me which way the trouble is walking today.

npcs.name: Maudie Tapwright
npcs.title: Innkeeper
npcs.greeting: Come in out of the damp, friend, and mind the step down to the fire. The kettle is on, the benches are warm, and the rooms upstairs are dry. Travelers from Fenbridge swear the marsh road is quiet by day, but nobody walks it after dark. Sit a while and rest your feet.

npcs.name: Instructor Maren
npcs.title: Proving Master
npcs.greeting: Every hero the vale has ever thanked stood where you stand now, {className}, and not one of them knew which end of a blade to hold. That is what this shore is for. Ask, practice, and fail where failing is free.

npcs.name: Keeper Bram
npcs.title: Keeper of the Old Beacon
npcs.greeting: Nine and thirty years this lamp has burned on my watch. It will not go dark on yours.

npcs.name: Keeper Saelwyn
npcs.title: Keeper of the Hollow
npcs.greeting: Few of your kind have stood beneath these boughs, {className}. Walk gently, and be welcome.

npcs.name: Lamplighter Sorrel
npcs.title: Keeper of the Nightgate
npcs.greeting: Mind the lamps, friend. Past this gate the sun gives up and the flowers take over.

npcs.name: Lampman Cobb
npcs.title: Keeper of the Crowgate Lanterns
npcs.greeting: Stay in the lamplight, friend. The wood counts everyone who passes the gate.

npcs.name: Lira Dewsong
npcs.title: Night-Gardener of Moonrest
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Moonrest, where the flowers do our dawning for us.

npcs.name: Hesper Elmsley
npcs.title: Keeper of the Elmhallow Lodge
npcs.greeting: The wold was old before the first hearth was lit. Walk softly. It remembers.

npcs.name: Loremaster Caddis
npcs.title: Loremaster
npcs.greeting: Mind the loose shale, {className}. The mountain has been... restless of late. I intend to learn why.

npcs.name: Loremother Bryn
npcs.title: Voice of the Shrine
npcs.greeting: Every light in this valley remembers something, {playerName}. Help me listen.

npcs.name: Warden Corren Stoutvale
npcs.title: Lanternwarden Commander
npcs.greeting: Keep your blade close, {className}. The Vale is not what it was.

npcs.name: Warden Corren Stoutvale
npcs.title: Lanternwarden Commander
npcs.greeting: Eastbrook can spare me for a week. The Dig cannot be spared another day.

npcs.name: Mender Saul
npcs.title: Field Surgeon
npcs.greeting: I have set more bones this one month than in ten years of mending fishing falls. The breaks do not leave much of what they take. Come back to me whole, if you can manage it.

npcs.name: Tobias Penhallow
npcs.title: Mine Captain of Wheal Patience
npcs.greeting: Wheal Patience. The name was a joke when we sank the shaft. Nobody is laughing now.

npcs.name: Mother Sedge
npcs.title: Fen-Witch of Willowweep
npcs.greeting: The willows told me you were coming before your boots left the bridge.

npcs.name: Muster Commander
npcs.title: Fenbridge Muster
npcs.greeting: Pikes first, {className}, then everyone. That is the whole of it, and it has kept this camp alive.

npcs.name: Netter Maris
npcs.title: Eel-Netter of Bridgemere
npcs.greeting: Smell that? Smoked eel. Half this town stands on stilts I bought with it.

npcs.name: Artificer Tobrin
npcs.title: Hearthwright Requisitioner
npcs.greeting: Sound timber, true steel, and honest work. Members of the Compact may draw from our stores.

npcs.name: Captain Althea
npcs.title: Lanternwarden Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: Keep a lamp lit and a road open. The Lanternwardens supply those who stand the watch with us.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Vaelen
npcs.title: Gilt Measure Factor
npcs.greeting: The Gilt Measure trades on what the coast gives up, and pays for what it learns. Our stores are open to those of recognized standing.

npcs.name: Taskmaster Kaelen
npcs.title: World Quest Taskmaster
npcs.greeting: The four allied factions post assignments across the realm every day. If an assignment does not suit your skills, you may request one daily reassignment.

npcs.name: Orchardist Pomeline
npcs.title: Keeper of the Gilded Rows
npcs.greeting: Mind where you step. Every root in these rows is older than the town, and they remember.

npcs.name: Overseer Pell
npcs.title: Gauntlet Overseer
npcs.greeting: I clock every run that comes down these lanes, {playerName}, and I have seen far worse footwork. The path behind me climbs to the practice yard: that is where footwork turns into swordwork.

npcs.name: Odda Brinewell
npcs.title: Pan-Reeve of Panwick
npcs.greeting: Panwick salts the fish of half the south. When the pans stop, people go hungry. So the pans do not stop.

npcs.name: Amos Eelby
npcs.title: Eel Fisher
npcs.greeting: Pull up a bench, {className}. Grissel here swears the big eel under Fenbridge is a myth. I've had my hand on him twice. Twice! Slippery as a tax collector, and near as long as this bench.

npcs.name: Grissel Sedgeworth
npcs.title: Peat Cutter
npcs.greeting: Don't mind Amos. Forty years cutting peat and I've pulled more strange things out of this bog than he's pulled eels: boots, bones, a helmet with the head still worried about it. Warm yourself, the fire's free.

npcs.name: Hester Quillby
npcs.title: Mapmaker
npcs.greeting: Every map of this marsh I've ever bought was wrong within a season. The water moves the paths, and the paths move the water. So I draw my own, and I sit here where it's dry while the ink sets.

npcs.name: Ned Oxley
npcs.title: Drover
npcs.greeting: Drove forty head down the causeway and lost two to the mire before Fenbridge. Maudie's ale is the only thing on this road that never lets a man down. Buy your own, mind.

npcs.name: Pearl-Mother Isha
npcs.title: Elder of the Divers
npcs.greeting: The sea gives, the sand keeps, and the jungle takes. Stay on the strand, stranger.

npcs.name: Wat Heathersby
npcs.title: Peat-Cutters Foreman
npcs.greeting: Mind where you put your feet. Half this moor is peat and the other half is pretending.

npcs.name: Provisioner Fenna
npcs.title: Eldershine Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Bread still warm, water still sweet. The Hollow provides, and so do I.

npcs.name: Provisioner Hale
npcs.title: Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Dry boots, dry bread, dry powder: at Fenbridge you get two of the three on a good day.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Bree
npcs.title: Highwatch Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: Wool, hardtack, and steel-shod boots: Highwatch runs on all three, and I am short of everything.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Edda
npcs.title: Redoubt Armorer
npcs.greeting: Steel and salt, {className}, it is all I have left to hand out. Take it and make the breaks regret opening where I could reach them.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Finch
npcs.title: Camp Outfitter
npcs.greeting: My counter keeps exactly one thing for sale, {playerName}: a spare pouch for what you pick up along the way, when your lesson calls for it. Everything else here is salvage bound for the vale. Coin buys the pouch, and work earns the coin. That is the whole economy, and it never gets more complicated. Only bigger.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Sela
npcs.title: Keeper of the Garrison Stores
npcs.greeting: Every crate in this yard crossed forty miles of ash to get here. Treat them kindly.

npcs.name: Reeve Ottoline
npcs.title: Reeve of Lanternmere
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Lanternmere, where the harvest never ends and neither does the work.

npcs.name: Riftwatch Ollun
npcs.title: Breach Scholar
npcs.greeting: Every break sings before it opens, if you have the ear for it. I can hear three of them stirring on the island right now, and one of them is close.

npcs.name: Riftwright Maelis
npcs.title: Rift Forgemaster
npcs.greeting: A Riftbound band remembers the break that made it, {className}. Bring me the band, and the essence the breaks shed, and I will teach it to remember more.

npcs.name: Jory Pannell
npcs.title: Salt Boiler
npcs.greeting: Breathe through your nose. You get used to the brine. Mostly.

npcs.name: Salvage-Boss Ryna
npcs.title: Mistress of the Wreck Line
npcs.greeting: A {className} with working arms, good. The wreck line pays well, if the crabs leave you enough fingers to count it.

npcs.name: Salvager Edda
npcs.title: Wreckfield Salvager
npcs.greeting: Wreckwood, rope, and dead men's cargo. The sea pays my wage, when the Warden lets it.

npcs.name: Scout Einna
npcs.title: Snowline Scout
npcs.greeting: You walked the pass alive. Good. Icemantle should hear of it.

npcs.name: Scout Maren
npcs.title: Marshal's Scout
npcs.greeting: Quiet feet and a short blade keep you breathing out here. Speak quick, for I am due back in the reeds.

npcs.name: Scout Maren
npcs.title: Marshal's Scout
npcs.greeting: I tracked cultists through the fen at your side, and the trail led here. The peaks are worse, {className}. Stay sharp.

npcs.name: Neris Snowmantle
npcs.title: Lanternwarden Scout
npcs.greeting: If the snow speaks, do not answer. Down here it is mostly the hedges, and they talk a great deal.

npcs.name: Scout Yerrin
npcs.title: Far-Dune Watcher
npcs.greeting: Keep low. Sound carries strangely off the glass, and the gate below has ears.

npcs.name: Ivo Bramwell
npcs.title: Causeway Watch Sergeant
npcs.greeting: The causeway is one road with the sea on both sides. I like it that way. Fewer directions to be ambushed from.

npcs.name: Sexton Marrow
npcs.title: Sexton of Gibbetmere
npcs.greeting: We bury them deep here, and we ring the bells so they remember to stay down.

npcs.name: Scout Valerie
npcs.title: Covert Operations
npcs.greeting: Borrow my duskweave cloak. Slip in behind each dispatch carrier and lift his orders. Stay out of the lantern beams: a lantern guard sees straight through the enchantment, and a carrier feels you if you brush against him.

npcs.name: Dispatch Guard
npcs.title: Dispatch Carrier
npcs.greeting: No delays. The watch is waiting for these orders.

npcs.name: Dispatch Guard
npcs.title: Dispatch Carrier
npcs.greeting: These sealed orders are for the captain. Keep your distance.

npcs.name: Dispatch Guard
npcs.title: Dispatch Carrier
npcs.greeting: I have a dispatch to deliver. Move along.

npcs.name: Dispatch Guard
npcs.title: Dispatch Carrier
npcs.greeting: Official business. Keep the path clear.

npcs.name: Lantern Sentry
npcs.title: True Sight
npcs.greeting: Nothing slips past the lantern watch.

npcs.name: Lantern Sentry
npcs.title: True Sight
npcs.greeting: My lantern reveals more than shadows. Stay where I can see you.

npcs.name: Lantern Watchman
npcs.title: True Sight
npcs.greeting: Nobody crosses my light unseen.

npcs.name: Lantern Watchman
npcs.title: True Sight
npcs.greeting: Hold there. The lantern sees what the eye misses.

npcs.name: Smith Haldren
npcs.title: Armorer & Weaponsmith
npcs.greeting: Mind the sparks, {className}. Good steel is the difference between a scar and a grave.

npcs.name: Maben Skerrit
npcs.title: the Socketwright
npcs.greeting: Forty years since I ground that eye and set it in his socket, and never a day paid. You want to hurt the Foreman, {className}? Aim for my work.

npcs.name: The Pale Keeper
npcs.title: Warden of the Dead
npcs.greeting: Rest now, spirit. I can return you to your body, but the crossing back leaves you weak.

npcs.name: Marla Hitchen
npcs.title: Stablemaster
npcs.greeting: Every rider walks in on two legs, {className}. I will not hand you the reins until you can sit the Valorsteed without kissing the dirt, and the Galecrest wind shows no mercy to a bad seat.

npcs.name: Strandwatcher Pell
npcs.title: Watcher of the Tanglemouth
npcs.greeting: Out of the black trees at last. Breathe, stranger, the sun holds this side of the pass.

npcs.name: Tanner Hesk
npcs.title: Master of the Tannery
npcs.greeting: A hide is only as good as its tanning, {className}. The vats are ready when you are.

npcs.name: Tamsin Tanwick
npcs.title: Tanner of the Yard
npcs.greeting: Fresh hides on the racks today, {className}. Scrape with the grain, never against it.

npcs.name: The Merchant
npcs.title: Keeper of the World Market
npcs.greeting: Welcome to the World Market, {className}. Buy from every adventurer in the realm, or set out your own wares and let coin find you.

npcs.name: Tidewarden Nel
npcs.title: Keeper of the Strand
npcs.greeting: The tide takes and the tide pays, {playerName}. I keep the tally of both: what the scuttlers pinch off the wrecks, and what honest hands carry back up this path.

npcs.name: Ondrel Vane
npcs.title: Tidewatcher
npcs.greeting: The mere drinks the moonlight, {className}, and gives back the drowned. I have watched that gate for thirty nights, and tonight it is open.

npcs.name: Tinker Gizzel
npcs.title: Master of the Toolworks
npcs.greeting: Springs, sprockets, and sharp edges, {className}: the toolworks has whatever your hands lack.

npcs.name: Silven Brackett
npcs.title: Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Fresh bread, clean water, fair prices. What can I get you?

npcs.name: Trapper Brosk
npcs.title: Shiverfen Trapper
npcs.greeting: Fen took three of my lines this week. Fen never took a line in twenty years.

npcs.name: Vicar Creel
npcs.title: Last Vicar of the Mournstone
npcs.greeting: The chapel fell years ago. The dead beneath it did not notice, and so I stayed.

npcs.name: Warden Coalfast
npcs.title: Redoubt Commander
npcs.greeting: The breaks do not care that Gullhaven is small, {className}. We hold this shore, or there is no shore left to hold. Stand with us and I will not forget it.

npcs.name: Warden Fenwick
npcs.title: Warden of Fenbridge
npcs.greeting: Hold at the gate, {className}. Past those reeds, the fen does the killing for us.

npcs.name: Warden Kaldra
npcs.title: Warden of Icemantle
npcs.greeting: Mind the benches, stranger. The snow keeps what it takes.

npcs.name: Warden Tam
npcs.title: Keeper of the Gauntlet
npcs.greeting: These lanes are the Gauntlet, {playerName}, and every adventurer the vale respects has run them. The lantern posts stay lit all night, so the lanes never close.

npcs.name: Tamsin Bracewell
npcs.title: Ferncross Camp Warden
npcs.greeting: The moor is quiet today. I have learned not to trust that, and I advise you to learn it faster than I did.

npcs.name: Wardsmith Orun
npcs.title: Keeper of the Old Forges
npcs.greeting: These forges cooled centuries ago, {className}, but their work still holds an edge.

npcs.name: Warmarshal Draven Kole
npcs.title: Master of the Warfare Stores
npcs.greeting: Honor is the only coin I take, and the Warfare stores are mine to guard. Earn your rank on the field and I will armor you for the next one.

npcs.name: Watcher Maren
npcs.title: The Windway Watch
npcs.greeting: Mind your footing past the gate. The wind up here takes hats first and questions never.

npcs.name: Wayfarer Bryn
npcs.title: Harbor Guide
npcs.greeting: Eastbrook takes all comers, friend. And for the unsteady, there is always the Proving Shore: the ferry bell down on the quay rings you across any day of the year, and its twin on the island rings you home.

npcs.name: Waykeeper Pell
npcs.title: Keeper of the Amberfen Steps
npcs.greeting: Down the Steps and into the soft country. Mind where you plant your boots.

npcs.name: Waywatcher Sorrel
npcs.title: Watcher of the Goldmelt
npcs.greeting: Snow behind you, gold ahead. Few walk the Goldmelt twice, so make the crossing count.

npcs.name: Weaver Amelle
npcs.title: Moonfleece Weaver
npcs.greeting: Feel that? Moonfleece on the loom. Warmer than any fire you have sat beside.

npcs.name: Weaver Ottilie
npcs.title: Master of the Loom
npcs.greeting: Mind the threads, {className}. A steady hand at the loom beats a strong one.

npcs.name: Cham Pete
npcs.title: Emissary
npcs.greeting: The Vale keeps a ledger of deeds, and I keep the ledger. Pick one charge for the week, see it through, and the purse is yours.

npcs.name: Wickmother Sorrel
npcs.title: Keeper of the Hedgewick Inn
npcs.greeting: Come in, sit, there is cordial on the fire. Just keep a hand on anything iron: the gnomes are light-fingered of late.

npcs.name: Widow Tansy
npcs.title: Candlewright of Gibbetmere
npcs.greeting: A candle for every grave, and not one may go out. Not one, do you hear me?

npcs.name: Keeper Liora
npcs.title: Warden of the Hedge Maze
npcs.greeting: Thieves hid their stolen gold all through my maze, and the shadows guard it now. Recover every coin purse. Avoid the guardians, or take a radiant wisp to banish them. Three lost lives return you to the entrance, but the purses you gathered remain safe.

specs.name: Battlecraft
specs.description: A master of arms who turns discipline and technique into his greatest strength. Every blow is calculated to break the enemy defense, exploit their weak points, and set up a devastating finisher. His combat is precise, methodical, and lethal, rewarding those who master the rhythm of battle. Signature: Maiming Strike.

specs.name: Bloodrush
specs.description: A berserker who fights with a weapon in each hand and lets rage drive his every move. The longer he fights, the greater his Enrage, unleashing a relentless storm of attacks that gives his enemies no respite. A frenzied, savage, aggressive style where the offensive never stops. Committing to Bloodrush unlocks dual wielding, and through Titan's Grip even a two-handed weapon in each hand, though wielding two-handers in both hands reduces physical damage dealt by 12%. Signature: Bloodletting.

specs.name: Ironguard
specs.description: The guardian who leads the front line with shield raised and unbreakable will. He withstands the assault of countless foes, protects his allies, and controls the battlefield with authority. He turns every blocked blow into a chance to answer with force. Signature: Shieldcrack.

options.name: Intervene
options.description: Rush to a friendly player, shielding them from 18 damage for 6 sec. Instant · 8-25 yd range · 30 sec cooldown

options.name: Pursuit
options.description: Each enemy you kill grants 30% movement speed for 6 sec.

options.name: Crushing Charge
options.description: Your Charge also roots the target for 4 sec and slows it by 50% for 15 sec.

options.name: Second Wind
options.description: Below 35% health, you regenerate 1.5% of your health per second.

options.name: Die by the Sword
options.description: Defensive cooldown: for 8 sec you take 30% less damage and dodge far more attacks. Instant · 120 sec cooldown

options.name: Victor's Surge
options.description: Strike for weapon damage plus 20% and heal 20% of your maximum health. Only usable within 20 sec of killing an enemy. Instant

options.name: Piercing Howl
options.description: A piercing shout that slows all enemies within 15 yards by 50% for 8 sec. 10 Rage · Instant

options.name: Thunderhurl
options.description: Hurl your weapon at the target for 18 to 26, stunning it for 3 sec. 10 Rage · Instant · 20 yd range · 30 sec cooldown

options.name: Lingering Dread
options.description: Enemies feared by your Intimidating Shout can endure 10% of their health in damage before the fear breaks.

options.name: Anger Management
options.description: Your auto-attacks generate 10% more rage and your abilities 5% more.

options.name: Combat Mastery
options.description: Your stances gain additional effects. Battle Stance: your ability criticals deal 15% more damage. Berserker Stance: your auto-attacks are 5% faster. Guarded Stance: a hit that would take at least 20% of your maximum health deals 15% less damage.

options.name: Battle Rhythm
options.description: Every third ability you use generates 20% more rage.

options.name: Recklessness
options.description: Enrage: your rage generation increases by 50% and your critical strike chance by 20% for 12 sec. Instant · 180 sec cooldown

options.name: Avatar
options.description: Transform into a colossus for 20 sec, breaking enemy control effects on you (boss control is unaffected) and increasing your damage dealt by 20%. Instant · 180 sec cooldown

options.name: Bloodbath
options.description: Each enemy you kill grants 5% critical strike and 5% damage dealt for 8 sec, stacking up to 25%.

options.name: Colossal Might
options.description: Each point of Rage you spend shaves 0.1 sec off the cooldown of your major offensive abilities, up to 10 sec every 30 sec.

options.name: Bladestorm
options.description: Become a whirling storm of steel, striking all enemies within 6 yards for 16 to 22 every second for 4 sec. 25 Rage · Channeled (4 sec) · 90 sec cooldown

options.name: Sanguine Aura
options.description: Imbue your weapon with the blood of your foes: you and your melee allies gain 10% attack speed and 10% damage for 20 sec. Instant · 180 sec cooldown

specs.name: Sunmender
specs.description: A devoted healer who turns the Light into steady single-target recovery. Signature: Mercy Lance.

specs.name: Faithwarden
specs.description: A shield-bearing defender who converts Holy power into threat and mitigation. Signature: Sunward Disc.

specs.name: Dawnreaver
specs.description: A holy warrior who judges enemies with weapon strikes and radiant burst. Signature: Final Edict.

options.name: Radiant Stride
options.description: Hammer of Grace grants 30% movement speed for 4 sec when it deals damage.

options.name: Steadfast Step
options.description: Solar Step lasts 2 sec longer and makes you immune to slows while active.

options.name: Divine Steed
options.description: Gain 0.75% movement speed per Devotion, up to 15% at 20. Activating Divine Ascension spends your Devotion and grants 30% movement speed for 5 sec.

options.name: Enduring Protection
options.description: Increases Ward of Faith's maximum-health absorption by 40% and makes it last 5 sec longer.

options.name: Steady Hands
options.description: Last Rite recharges 30% faster and heals the target for another 30% of its direct healing over 6 sec.

options.name: Recurring Grace
options.description: Hammer of Grace overhealing becomes an absorb shield for 10 sec, capped at 10% of your maximum health.

options.name: Fist of Justice
options.description: Sundering Gavel's cooldown is reduced by 25%.

options.name: Double Sentence
options.description: Sundering Gavel stores 2 uses.

options.name: Radiant Shackles
options.description: Hammer of Grace slows its target by 40% for 4 sec.

options.name: Zeal
options.description: Every third ability that actually generates Devotion grants 1 extra Devotion.

options.name: Sacred Reserve
options.description: When Divine Ascension ends, regain 5 Devotion.

options.name: Divine Purpose
options.description: Ascension-empowered abilities have a 20% chance not to consume a charge.

options.name: Extended Dawn
options.description: Divine Ascension empowers 2 additional abilities.

options.name: Radiant Wrath
options.description: Zealwing lasts 5 sec longer (20 sec total) and its cooldown is reduced to 100 sec.

options.name: Sanctified Fervor
options.description: Zealwing also grants 15% critical strike chance and 15% haste.

options.name: Sacred Concord
options.description: For 8 sec, empower every active Devotion and Requital Aura in your group. Bastion Devotion reduces damage by 15%; Requital deals 15 Holy damage. Multiple uses refresh instead of stacking. Instant · 120 sec cooldown

options.name: Dawn Echo
options.description: Every third direct ability that actually generates Devotion repeats its primary direct damage or healing at 40% on the same target. An effective echo grants 1 Devotion. The echo cannot crit or trigger other echoes, and grants no Devotion during Divine Ascension.

options.name: Perpetual Sun
options.description: Consuming your last Ascension charge deals 150 Holy damage within 10 m, heals allies within 20 m for 150, then doubles ability Devotion generation for 5 sec. Expiration does not trigger it.

specs.name: Packlord
specs.description: A wild commander who builds Pack Ferocity and unleashes a growing companion. Signature: Howling Rage.

specs.name: Coldsight
specs.description: A deliberate archer who builds Focus and commits to precision shots. Signature: Cold Focus.

specs.name: Fieldcraft
specs.description: A melee-first skirmisher who tears one wound and controls re-entry. Signature: Bloodhook.

options.name: Tactical Retreat
options.description: Trailbreak stores 2 uses.

options.name: Enduring Courser
options.description: Courser's Guise grants 60% movement speed for 3 sec when activated. 20 sec internal cooldown.

options.name: Predator's Pace
options.description: A successful Pack Command, Measured Shot, or Gutting Strike grants 20% movement speed for 3 sec. 8 sec internal cooldown.

options.name: Receding Shell
options.description: Recast Shellskin to end it early and refund 50% of its unused duration, up to 45 sec.

options.name: Shared Recovery
options.description: Wildheart also heals your pet for 30% and grants both of you 20% damage reduction for 4 sec.

options.name: Lonely Soul
options.description: Redirect 30% of damage taken to a living pet without reducing it below 20% health. Without a living pet, deal 10% more damage.

options.name: Double Hush
options.description: Hushing Shot stores 2 uses, each recharging 4 sec slower (19 sec).

options.name: Binding Payload
options.description: Your traps root every enemy in their trigger area for 3 sec, then slow them by 40% for 4 sec.

options.name: Crippling Pursuit
options.description: Rattling Shot or Fettering Slash roots an already slowed target for 2 sec. 12 sec per-target cooldown.

options.name: Efficient Rhythm
options.description: After spending 75 Focus, your next Pack Command, Measured Shot, or Gutting Strike grants 20 additional Focus.

options.name: Trapcraft
options.description: Each trap's cooldown is reduced by 20%. Triggering a trap restores 20 Focus and reduces Trailbreak's cooldown by 5 sec.

options.name: Guise Mastery
options.description: For 6 sec, Harrier's Guise increases Focus generation by 50%, Marten's Guise reduces direct damage by 25%, and Courser's Guise grants 50% movement speed, or 60% with Enduring Courser. 20 sec shared cooldown.

options.name: Apex Instinct
options.description: Howling Rage, Cold Focus, or Bloodtrail Assault restores 40 Focus. Your next 3 Focus spenders cost 50% less and deal 20% more damage. These uses expire 4 sec after the triggering cooldown ends.

options.name: Shell and Fang
options.description: Shellskin allows attacks and pet commands, but its damage reduction is reduced to 40%.

options.name: Pack Rally
options.description: Courser's Guise can trigger Pack Rally. You, your companion, and group or raid allies within 30 yards gain 30% movement speed and 10% attack, casting, and channeling speed for 10 sec. 90 sec cooldown.

options.name: Overdraw
options.description: Every 3rd Fell Shot, Long Draw, or Woundrend deals 35% more damage to its target and 50% of that damage to up to 2 enemies within 5 yards.

options.name: Chain Reaction
options.description: Your traps mark enemies within 4 yards for 8 sec when triggered. Your next 3 Focus spenders echo 40% damage between marked enemies.

options.name: Fang Chorus
options.description: Each Focus spender commands a 50%-strength pet echo. Every 3rd echo becomes a 4 yd clap.

specs.name: Knifework
specs.description: A poison specialist. Your strikes add Venom Ritual; at 6, Dirt Nap becomes Venomrend, which cashes in all your bleeds at once and plants a fresh wound. Signature: Killer's Calm.

specs.name: Thuggery
specs.description: A stand-up brawler. A 4+ combo Dirt Nap starts Redline for 8 sec: your strikes become Haymakers that build it up, and Lights Out spends it all before the timer ends. Signature: Mirrored Blades.

specs.name: Skulduggery
specs.description: A stealth striker. Openers from Duskveil add Gloam; at 3 Gloam your openers work without stealth, and the next one is free and starts the Shadow Veil, doubling your first Lurker's Strike inside it. Signature: Red Ribbon.

options.name: Shadeslip
options.description: Steps through the shadows to your target, friend or foe, without breaking Duskveil. Stores up to 2 charges. Instant · 24 yd range · 24 sec cooldown

options.name: Killer's Pace
options.description: Killing blows grant 40% movement speed for 6 sec.

options.name: Quickstep
options.description: Landing Wicked Slash or Craven Thrust grants 20% movement speed for 2 sec. Once every 8 sec.

options.name: Borrowed Breath
options.description: A blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead. Once every 120 sec.

options.name: Ghostfoot Ward
options.description: Ghostfoot also reduces all damage you take by 30% while it is active.

options.name: Smoke Screen
options.description: Vanish into a cloud of smoke, increasing your chance to dodge by 30% for 8 sec. 25 Energy · Instant · 30 sec cooldown

options.name: Marked Prey
options.description: Enemies you stun with Gut Punch or Low Blow take 10% more damage from all attackers for 6 sec.

options.name: Foul Play
options.description: Eye Jab and Sap cost no energy, and your own poisons and bleeds no longer break your Eye Jab.

options.name: Cheap Trick
options.description: Gut Punch no longer requires Duskveil.

options.name: Dusk Economy
options.description: Abilities cost 50% less energy while in Duskveil or shadow-wreathed by the veil, and for 6 sec after leaving Duskveil.

options.name: Venom Dividend
options.description: Landed melee auto-attacks with an active poison have a 20% chance to restore 10 energy. Once every 2 sec.

options.name: Ceaseless Cuts
options.description: Every 3rd Wicked Slash restores 50 energy. (Combat)

options.name: Flurry of Knives
options.description: Lash every enemy within 6 yd with thrown knives for 48 to 62 Physical damage and gain 2 combo points. 35 Energy · Instant · 45 sec cooldown

options.name: Ghostfoot Gambit
options.description: Ghostfoot restores 30 energy and makes your next builder within 8 sec cost 50% less energy.

options.name: Thieves' Chorus
options.description: A whistled signal spurs your group on, increasing attack, casting, and channeling speed by 10% for 10 sec. Allies recently affected by a group haste burst are too exhausted to benefit. 25 Energy · Instant · 90 sec cooldown

options.name: Second Shadow
options.description: Dirt Nap cast at 5 combo points strikes again from the shadows for 75% of its damage.

options.name: Grave Brand
options.description: Your Duskveil openers brand the target for 20 sec. You deal 12% more damage to the branded target.

options.name: Kill Chain
options.description: Killing blows refresh Smokefade and grant 5 combo points.

specs.name: Doctrine
specs.description: A mitigator who shields allies and heals through controlled efficiency. Signature: Scouring Mercy.

specs.name: Benison
specs.description: A direct healer with strong throughput and restorative prayers. Signature: Seraphic Vigil.

specs.name: Vespers
specs.description: A damage caster built around Shadow damage over time and mind spells. Signature: Call Tithefiend.

options.name: Sheltering Step
options.description: Psalm of Warding grants its target 40% movement speed for 3 sec.

options.name: Veil Unbound
options.description: Veilstep removes roots and slows, then grants 50% movement speed for 3 sec.

options.name: Processional Grace
options.description: Veilstep allows the Priest to cast while moving for 4 sec.

options.name: Last Prayer
options.description: Instantly heals you for 30% of maximum health. Instant · 90 sec cooldown

options.name: Shattered Psalm
options.description: When Psalm of Warding is fully consumed, it heals its target for 12% maximum health.

options.name: Wounded Halo
options.description: A hit for at least 15% maximum health grants a 15% absorb for 10 sec. 20 sec internal cooldown.

options.name: Hushword
options.description: Silences the target for 4 sec. 55 Mana · Instant · 30 yd range · 30 sec cooldown

options.name: Lingering Dread
options.description: Reduces Terror Canticle's cooldown by 30%. Feared enemies remain 50% slowed for 4 sec.

options.name: Binding Psalm
options.description: An enemy that fully consumes Psalm of Warding is rooted for 2 sec, once per enemy every 12 sec.

options.name: Stilled Mind
options.description: Grants Stilled Mind. Your next Priest spell within 60 sec costs no Mana and cannot be interrupted. Shadow: separately reserves a guaranteed critical strike for your next Mindfracture or Void Rupture within 60 sec, if it hits. Other spells do not consume this bonus. Void Rupture still consumes 3 Gloomtithe charges. A resisted cast consumes the critical strike bonus. Instant · 90 sec cooldown

options.name: Measured Faith
options.description: Every 3rd Mana-spending Priest spell makes the next Priest spell within 10 sec cost 50% less Mana.

options.name: Living Covenant
options.description: Doctrine damage-healing restores Psalm of Warding by 20% of the healing done, up to its original absorb. Benison turns Choirmend overhealing into a 10 sec absorb capped at 10% maximum health. Shadow: landed Mindfracture hits on your Effigy extend your Dirge of Decay and Vampiric Touch by 1 sec, up to 3 sec per application. Echoes extend Dirge on other enemies by 1 sec, up to 6 sec per application. Extensions preserve the next tick and do not generate Gloomtithe.

options.name: Anointing
options.description: Anoints a friendly target, increasing damage, healing, and casting speed by 20% for 15 sec. 55 Mana · Instant · 30 yd range · 120 sec cooldown

options.name: Martyr's Aegis
options.description: Reduce one ally's incoming damage by 40% for 8 sec. 80 Mana · Instant · 30 yd range · 120 sec cooldown

options.name: Choir of Deliverance
options.description: Channel for 6 sec, healing party members within 30 yards for 90 to 110 every 2 sec. Healing increases with Spell Power. 128 Mana · Channeled (6 sec) · 180 sec cooldown

options.name: Twin Covenant
options.description: Doctrine can link 2 allies and converts 70% of Holy damage into healing for each. Benison stores 2 Seraphic Vigil uses and can protect 2 allies. Shadow can bind 2 enemies as Effigies with Dirge of Decay and Mindfracture. Dirge ticks on both generate Gloomtithe for the same bank and Tithe Bomb.

options.name: Second Verse
options.description: Doctrine repeats 40% of Scouring Mercy healing after 2 sec. Benison repeats 40% of group healing after 2 sec. Shadow: every 5th regular Vampiric Touch tick on your Effigy adds one extra damage tick, with its normal healing from enemy health lost. Refreshing your Vampiric Touch before it expires preserves the count on that enemy. If it expires, the count resets. Extra ticks cannot trigger themselves.

options.name: Incarnate Spirit
options.description: Doctrine: a fully consumed Psalm of Warding heals its target for 40% of the original absorb. Benison: Vigil healing also heals up to 3 party members within 15 yards for 40%. Shadow: Tithe Bomb leaves an 8-yard zone for 6 sec, dealing an additional 20% of its noncritical damage over 3 pulses, one every 2 sec. Damage is reduced beyond 5 targets. Enemies must remain in the zone.

specs.name: Thundercall
specs.description: A ranged caster who calls lightning, flame, and frost. Signature: Primal Mastery.

specs.name: Warspirit
specs.description: A weapon fighter who channels the storm through melee swings. Signature: Ancestral Strike.

specs.name: Spiritcall
specs.description: A healer using ancestral waves and efficient nature magic. Signature: Cascading Mend.

options.name: Wolfstep
options.description: Shadewolf becomes instant. Entering it removes roots and movement slows.

options.name: Gathering Winds
options.description: Entering Shadewolf grants 60% movement speed for 3 sec, once every 20 sec.

options.name: Flowing Elements
options.description: After using a Jolt, the next Arc Bolt or Mending Waters started within 8 sec can be cast while moving.

options.name: Stoneward
options.description: Protects one ally for 60 sec with 6 charges. Damage consumes a charge to heal 5% maximum health, once every 3 sec. 40 Mana · Instant · 30 yd range

options.name: Warded Elements
options.description: Thunder Ward retaliation grants 10% damage reduction for 3 sec.

options.name: Ancestral Mending
options.description: Taking a hit for at least 15% of your maximum health heals you for 12% of maximum health. 20 sec internal cooldown.

options.name: Fault Rebuke
options.description: Earthen Jolt interrupts spellcasting for a 4 sec school lockout.

options.name: Rime Lock
options.description: Rime Jolt roots the target for 2 sec.

options.name: Gripping Earth
options.description: Roots enemies within 4 yd of the target point for 2 sec, then slows them by 40% for 6 sec. 45 Mana · Instant · 30 yd range · 30 sec cooldown

options.name: Flow State
options.description: After spending 120 Mana, your next Shaman action that costs Mana costs 40 less. The ready state has no short expiry.

options.name: Imbue Mastery
options.description: Pyrebrand grants 1 extra Thunder charge every 3rd Arc Bolt. Galeheart echoes deal 25% more damage, Stonebound gains 5% damage reduction, and Lifespring deposits 20% more Mending Current.

options.name: Ward Cycle
options.description: A successful Arc Bolt, Ancestral Strike, or Mending Waters restores 1 Thunder Ward charge and 10 Mana, once every 6 sec.

options.name: Primal Exaltation
options.description: For 12 sec, Thundercall Arc Bolt and Skybranch cast 50% faster, while Arc Bolt grants 2 Thunder; Warspirit triggers its cadence every 2 weapon hits; Spiritcall adds 50% more healing to Mending Current. Instant · 120 sec cooldown

options.name: Wayfarer Grace
options.description: When ready, exiting Shadewolf allows casting while moving for 8 sec. 90 sec internal cooldown.

options.name: Ancestral Bulwark
options.description: Activating Thunder Ward grants 40% damage reduction for 6 sec. 120 sec internal cooldown.

options.name: Deep Reservoir
options.description: After Earthen Jolt or Faultwake consumes a full Thunder bank, retain 2 Thunder. After a spell consumes Stormcast, retain 1 Warspirit Cadence step. After Cascading Mend consumes Mending Current, restore 25% of the amount consumed.

options.name: Echoing Elements
options.description: After Earthen Jolt or Faultwake consumes a full Thunder bank, repeat 40% of its damage after 1 sec. A spell that consumes Stormcast repeats at 40% strength. Healing from consumed Mending Current repeats at 40% strength after 2 sec. These repeats cannot trigger other effects.

options.name: Living Weapon
options.description: After Earthen Jolt or Faultwake consumes a full Thunder bank, Pyrebrand makes the next Arc Bolt instant. Galeheart's echoes each deal 40% damage to up to 2 enemies within 8 yards. A Stonebound spell that consumes Stormcast grants an absorb equal to 8% of your maximum health. With Lifespring active, Tidecall also adds 50% of its full heal to the most injured ally within 10 yards.

specs.name: Chronomancy
specs.description: A mage who manipulates time and aether to protect allies. They can anticipate wounds, repeat healing, and reverse damage before it is too late. Signature: Temporal Mend.

specs.name: Pyromancy
specs.description: A master of flame who chains critical strikes into devastating explosions. Fast, aggressive, and capable of igniting many enemies. Signature: Pyrelance.

specs.name: Cryomancy
specs.description: A spellcaster who controls the battlefield with ice, slows, and freezes. They build glacial power to destroy enemies with precise attacks. Signature: Ice Lance.

options.name: Ice Floes
options.description: Your next two spells with a cast time can be cast while moving. Lasts 15 sec. Instant · 25 sec cooldown

options.name: Double Blink
options.description: Flitstep stores 2 charges, but each recharges 30% more slowly.

options.name: Blink While Casting
options.description: You can use Flitstep in the middle of a cast without interrupting it.

options.name: Warded
options.description: While your personal barrier is up you take 15% less damage, and it heals its bearer for 10% of your maximum health when it breaks after absorbing.

options.name: Shifting Ward
options.description: Casting your personal barrier breaks roots affecting you.

options.name: Greater Invisibility
options.description: Vanish for 20 sec and remove 2 damage-over-time effects. When the invisibility ends, take 90% less damage for 2 sec. 60 Mana · Instant · 120 sec cooldown

options.name: Ring of Frost
options.description: Summons a ring for 10 sec. Enemies crossing its perimeter are frozen for 4 sec. 60 Mana · 1.5 sec cast · 25 yd range · 30 sec cooldown

options.name: Snap Bewitch
options.description: Bewitch becomes instant, on a 20 sec cooldown.

options.name: Twin Icebind
options.description: Icebind stores 2 charges that recharge independently.

options.name: Power Echo
options.description: Your next direct spell repeats at 50% power on the same target. Lasts 10 sec. Instant · 30 sec cooldown

options.name: Overload
options.description: Your next spell is amplified by 40% but costs 50% more mana. Lasts 10 sec. Instant · 30 sec cooldown

options.name: Racing Mind
options.description: Makes your next spell with a cast time instant. Lasts 60 sec. Instant · 60 sec cooldown

options.name: Elemental Convergence
options.description: Alternating a Fire and a Frost spell opens an 8 sec surge of power, once per 30 sec.

options.name: Winter's Recall
options.description: Finishes the cooldown on Flitstep, Frostveil, and Greater Invisibility. Instant · 120 sec cooldown

options.name: Mass Barrier
options.description: Shields you and up to 4 nearby allies within 30 yd, each absorbing 250 damage for 15 sec. 150 Mana · Instant · 90 sec cooldown

options.name: Rune of Power
options.description: Inscribe a rune of power at your feet for 15 sec: allies standing within 8 yd deal 10% more damage. 100 Mana · 1.5 sec cast · 45 sec cooldown

options.name: Overflowing Power
options.description: Spending mana shaves the cooldown of your defensives: 2 sec per tenth of your maximum mana spent, up to 10 sec every 30 sec.

options.name: Aetherwell
options.description: Channel for 6 sec: each second restores 100 mana and builds 8 spell power, stacking while you channel and lasting 15 sec. Channeled (6 sec) · 120 sec cooldown

specs.name: Hexcraft
specs.description: A curse-weaver who turns enemy and allied actions into Condemnation. Signature: Evil Eye.

specs.name: Necromancy
specs.description: A master of Soul Fragments who raises and commands an undead army. Signature: Lich Form.

specs.name: Ruination
specs.description: A siege caster who builds Wrack and spends it on overwhelming fire. Signature: Conflagrate.

options.name: Grave Rhythm
options.description: Umbral Anchor recovers 15 sec faster.

options.name: Blacktide
options.description: Returning to Umbral Anchor grants 40% movement speed for 4 sec.

options.name: Sacrilegious March
options.description: Increases movement speed by 35%, but sacrifices 2% of your maximum health each second. Cast again to cancel. It switches off at 20% health. Instant

options.name: Improved Abyssal Gag
options.description: Improves Abyssal Gag and grants it two levels early. It interrupts the enemy and silences all of its spells for 4 sec.

options.name: Dread Chorus
options.description: Frightens nearby enemies for up to 5 sec. Damage totaling 8% of a target's maximum health breaks its fear. 55 Mana · Instant · 40 sec cooldown

options.name: Leaden Hex
options.description: Damaging spells apply a 10% slow for 5 sec, stacking 3 times. At 3 stacks, the next spell roots for 3.5 sec and consumes them. A target can be rooted once every 15 sec.

options.name: Pact Deepened
options.description: Fiendhide grants 100% more armor and reduces magic damage taken by 5% while active.

options.name: Sanguine Covenant
options.description: Sacrifices 10% of your current health to absorb damage equal to 30% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Instant · 45 sec cooldown

options.name: Deep Hunger
options.description: The first time each group member touches your Soulwell, it shields them for 15% of their maximum health for 30 sec. Each player can gain this shield once per Soulwell.

options.name: Deepened Hex
options.description: Your specialization's primary generator costs 25% less mana.

options.name: Blood Credit
options.description: Hard Bargain and Cruel Pact restore 50% more mana for the same health.

options.name: Shadow Credit
options.description: Each time you spend at least 40% of your specialization resource, you gain 1 free generator. Spending at least 80% at once grants 2. Separate triggers can accumulate up to 2 charges.

options.name: Grand Malediction
options.description: Reduces your specialization's setup cooldown by 25%: Hex of Violence (Affliction; punishes the enemy's damaging actions), Unholy Command (Necromancy; briefly empowers all your undead), or Ruinous Brand (Destruction; echoes your direct spells).

options.name: Ashen Focus
options.description: After standing still for 1 sec, your specialization's primary generator casts 20% faster. Moving removes the benefit immediately.

options.name: Hexstorm
options.description: Every 3rd primary generator makes your specialization's next generator within 8 sec instant, at most once every 10 sec.

options.name: Unbroken Ritual
options.description: Each second spent casting or channeling reduces the remaining cooldown of your Warlock class and specialization abilities by 0.5 sec. Does not affect capstone talents.

options.name: Forbidden Reflection
options.description: The first Warlock class or specialization ability with a cooldown that you use, except Soulwell and Army of the Dead, creates a forbidden reflection. You may use that same ability once more within 10 sec for its normal cost without starting another cooldown. This effect can occur once every 60 sec.

options.name: Abyssal Rift
options.description: Tears open a rift at the selected location, pulling enemies within 8 yards to its center, dealing 110 to 130 Shadow damage, and stunning them for 2 sec. Bosses take damage but resist the pull and stun. 100 Mana · Instant · 30 yd range · 45 sec cooldown

specs.name: Moongrove
specs.description: A Moonwing caster whose casts fill the Moontide; at 3 you choose how to spend it: Moonsurge for damage or Sunwake for mana. Signature: Moonwing Form.

specs.name: Wildfang
specs.description: A shapeshifter whose landed hits build Old Blood in both forms: Cat spends it for damage, Bruin spends it to tank. Reaches 1 yd further with every melee attack, and melee autoattacks grant Nature's Boon about every 15 sec: for 10 sec, one free Sporemending castable in any form and 50% stronger, or one free Oakhide in Bruin Form and 25% stronger. Signature: Primal Surge.

specs.name: Groveheart
specs.description: A healer who grows Verdance with completed HoT casts and harvests the garden with Overbloom. Ticks of your heal-over-time effects grant Nature's Boon (at most once every 10 sec): for 10 sec, one Wildmend that is instant, free, castable in any form, and 25% stronger. Signatures: Fleetmend and Sporemender Form.

options.name: Wildshift
options.description: Shapeshifting into Cat, Bruin, Moonwing, or Sporemender Form removes breakable roots and slows.

options.name: Longstride
options.description: Loping Stride lasts 5 sec and its cooldown is 12 sec.

options.name: Skylark
options.description: Wildbolt, Skyfall, Wildmend, and Second Bloom are castable while moving.

options.name: Oakhide Reflex
options.description: Oakhide gains 50% more armor and its cooldown is reduced by 20 sec.

options.name: Ironhide Reflex
options.description: Taking a hit for at least 20% of maximum health shields you for 15% of maximum health for 6 sec. 20 sec internal cooldown.

options.name: Bear-Blood Mending
options.description: Taking a hit for at least 20% of maximum health heals you for 12% of maximum health. 20 sec internal cooldown.

options.name: Typhoon
options.description: A blast of wind hurls all enemies within 8 yd 15 yd away from you and dazes them, slowing their movement by 50% for 4 sec. Enemy players are thrown into the air in a straight line: knocked off a ledge, they keep going and take falling damage, and a fatal fall counts as your kill. 30 Mana · Instant · 20 sec cooldown

options.name: Gripping Ambush
options.description: Gripping Roots makes your next Wildbolt within 8 sec instant, at most once every 15 sec.

options.name: Concussive Economy
options.description: Concuss restores 15 rage and removes 20 sec from its cooldown.

options.name: Blooddrunk
options.description: Each tick of your Flense and Bloodrift bleeds also adds 1 Old Blood.

options.name: Highmoon Tithe
options.description: Moonsurge and Sunwake each also restore 15% of your maximum mana.

options.name: Seedspread
options.description: Overbloom replants a fresh Sporemending on every ally whose healing it harvested.

options.name: Red Haze
options.description: Increases attack power by 70 for 15 sec. Instant · 180 sec cooldown

options.name: Gladesong
options.description: Channels restorative energy for 4 sec, healing allies within 30 yd for 42 to 52 each second. 240 Mana · Channeled (4 sec) · 60 sec cooldown

options.name: Lifesap
options.description: Living sap wells up in you for 10 sec, restoring 20 of your current resource in waves: mana, Rage, or Energy, and shifting forms does not break it. Sleep, stun, or stasis stills the sap. Instant · 90 sec cooldown

options.name: Nature's Echo
options.description: After you spend Moontide, Old Blood, or Verdance, it starts refilling with 1 already gained.

options.name: Wild Apex
options.description: Moonsurge, Sunwake, Redharvest, Marrowbreak, and Overbloom are 25% stronger.

options.name: Quickening
options.description: Every 1 of Moontide, Old Blood, or Verdance you gain restores 2% of your maximum mana, 5 energy, or 3 rage, matching your current form.
